note: Default setups for maps whose wiki pages give none (Inferno, Nuke) or describe an older layout (Cache). One position or rule per line. Sources are dated written guides cached in data/raw/web (see fetch.WEB). "q" maps each cited source to the passages it is quoted for; build.py fails if a quote is not character for character in that very source (only white space may differ), if a cited source has no quote, if a number is not in it, or if a {Map|callout} is not on that map's callout map. The build counts how many of a line's sources are dated in the last 60 days and the page shows it on every line (a meta claim needs two). These are common starting points, not the one right setup.
